articles.title: Nato and EU condemn Russia after drone hits Romanian residential block
articles.description: Romania says the Russian drone was likely hit over Ukraine by its air defences and altered its trajectory.

articles.title: 'Controversial' North Korean invasion setting for next Call of Duty game
articles.description: Developer Infinity Ward said the game will be "grounded in the military authenticity" the series is known for.

articles.title: Eight students arrested in Kenya after suspected deadly school arson attack
articles.description: Sixteen pupils died in the fire that ripped through a dormitory while they were asleep.

articles.title: Gaza City hospitals say several killed in strike, as Israel targets Hamas leaders
articles.description: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

articles.title: Man jailed for 15 years over plot to attack Taylor Swift concert in Vienna
articles.description: A 21-year-old Austrian man is found guilty of planning the attack and other terrorism-related offences.

articles.title: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
articles.description: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.
